description: A Git intelligence MCP server built with Node.js and TypeScript that analyzes local Git repositories to surface insights like hotspots, churn, temporal coupling, knowledge maps, and risk scoring. Designed for AI agents, it exposes repository analytics tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) while keeping all data local and read-only.
